question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution: The correct answer is "**ties**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • In the context of the sentence, we **need a word that describes the social and cultural reasons for migration**. • Among the options given, **"ties" in option 2 is the most appropriate** word to fill in the blank number 2. • **"Ties" refers to the connections and relationships** people have** with their family and clan**, which can be a powerful motivator for migration. • Example: *The **ties **of the mafia with local police are strong.* • Thus,** "ties" in option 2 is the best fit **and provides a meaningful sentence that** highlights the role of social and cultural factors in migration.** Correct Passage__: *Human migration may be traced all the way back to the (1) __dawn__ of time, and humans have been on the move ever since. Climate change, war and displacement, economic considerations, living conditions, family and clan **(2) __ties__**, and, more recently, educational possibilities are all reasons for migration. Because there are several reasons for migration, migration patterns are (3)_________. Potential migrants will not only (4)_________ whether or not to migrate, but also where they will go. Individuals with (5) ________ observed and unobserved features will make diverse decisions and self-select into specific areas.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's understand the meaning of the remaining options: Word Meaning Joins a place or line where two or more things are connected or fastened together.(वह स्थान या रेखा जहाँ दो या दो से अधिक वस्तुएँ जुड़ी हों) chains a connected flexible series of metal links used for fastening or securing objects and pulling or supporting loads.(वस्तुओं को जोड़ने या सुरक्षित करने के लिए उपयोग की जाने वाली धातु कड़ियों की एक जुड़ी हुई लचीली श्रृंखला) fights take part in a violent struggle involving the exchange of physical blows or the use of weapons.(एक हिंसक संघर्ष में भाग लेना जिसमें शारीरिक मारपीट का आदान-प्रदान शामिल हो) 44:T1266, The correct answer is "**diverse**".
